items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Sonny Clay's Eccentric Harmony Six...uh, in 1922, had William Hansett on cornet, Archie Grant on trombone and piano, Cash Green--which they say may be Charles Green...

ctx.x: Well, I must have different, you know. I went... you know, when I went to sleep this morning, it was a quarter after six. I laid there all night long, read the paper, read the Bible, read the songbooks, read the...heh heh...everything I could get.
Sonny Clay's Eccentric Harmony Six...uh, in 1922, had William Hansett on cornet, Archie Grant on trombone and piano, Cash Green--which they say may be Charles Green...
